evidence.note: The video element (and onPlaying) only mounts while active; the element atom writes playing false whenever the ref is null on unmount.
posterHidden is active && playing; playing is only set true from onPlaying on that active-mounted video, so playing implies active.

notes: Clip playback phase idle|armed|playing. layered remains an independent layout flag already triaged on HeroClipLayer.

disqualifier.note: isDragging is an ephemeral pointer overlay on DocumentIntakeState; configured is vault-root presence on DocumentIntakeSurface. dragEnter refuses to set isDragging unless configured, but that is a permission guard: pending vs needsOnboarding share !configured independently, and a config reload can drop configured while a drag latch is still true.
Independent axes forwarded to ChatComposer: streaming is shell.turnActive; sendDisabled is Option.isSome(safetyGate). Combined-true is legal (Stop while a refused draft remains).
